EX-99.1 2 ex_1046129.htm EXHIBIT 99.1 ex_1046129.htm Exhibit 99.1 Moleculin Biotech Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results as Pivotal MIRACLE Trial Advances Toward Key Q1 2027 Data Readout - Completed treatment of all 90 patients in Part A of the pivotal Phase 2/3 MIRACLE trial evaluating Annamycin in relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (AML) - Comprehensive Part A data readout remains on track for the first quarter of 2027, supporting optimal dose selection and planned initiation of Part B - Annamycin's differentiated cardiac safety profile further supported by peer-reviewed analysis of 90 patients across five clinical trials, with no evidence of clinical or subclinical cardiotoxicity at first interim analysis - New preclinical findings suggest Annamycin may help turn immunologically “ cold ” pancreatic tumors “ hot, ” supporting potential combination treatment approaches HOUSTON, November 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Moleculin Biotech, Inc. , (Nasdaq: MBRX) (“Moleculin” or the “Company”), reported on Friday the financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, and highlighted continued progress across its clinical development programs, including completion of treatment in Part A of its pivotal Phase 2/3 MIRACLE trial evaluating Annamycin (also known as naxtarubicin) in relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (AML).
These data are expected to support selection of the optimal Annamycin dose for advancement into Part B, which is currently planned to begin in the first half of 2027.

Recent Highlights ● Completed treatment for all 90 patients in Part A of the Phase 2/3 MIRACLE trial evaluating Annamycin in combination with cytarabine for relapsed or refractory AML.
The Company remains on track for a comprehensive data readout in the first quarter of 2027.

Expected Milestones for the Annamycin Development Program ● Q1 2027: MIRACLE – Comprehensive Part A data readout following completion of treatment for all 90 patients ● 1H 2027: MIRACLE – Planned initiation of Part B following optimal dose selection ● 1H 2027: Planned initiation of physician-sponsored clinical trial evaluating Annamycin for pancreatic cancer ● 1H 2028: Planned initiation of third-line relapsed/refractory AML subject trial ● 1H 2028: Planned initiation of pediatric AML clinical study ● 2H 2028: Complete recruitment of Part B ● 2H 2028: Primary efficacy data for MIRACLE 2nd line subjects ● 2028-2029: Begin a rolling submission of a New Drug Application (NDA) for the treatment of R/R AML for accelerated approval on primary endpoint of CR from MIRACLE Additional Pipeline Programs Moleculin continues to support development activities for its WP1066 program through investigator-sponsored research, including a physician-sponsored Phase 1B/2 clinical trial evaluating WP1066 in combination with radiation for the treatment of glioblastoma.

Forward-looking statements in this press release include, without limitation: the potential efficacy and safety of Annamycin; the potential for Annamycin to be used in combination with immune checkpoint inhibitors or in indications other than AML; the timing and results of the comprehensive Part A data readout of the MB-108 trial; the planned initiation of Part B of the MIRACLE trial in the first half of 2027 and the expected timeline for completing Part B recruitment; the potential for the MB-108 trial to support a New Drug Application submission, including the anticipated rolling NDA submission during 2028-2029; the planned initiation of a third-line relapsed/refractory AML clinical study and a pediatric AML clinical study, each anticipated in the first half of 2028; the Company’s plans to sponsor an investigator-initiated clinical trial of Annamycin in pancreatic cancer; and the Company’s ability to secure additional financing to conduct its clinical trials.
